name: voiceprint
description: Builds your own writing-voice skill from evidence, not adjectives. Unlike tools that analyze old posts and hand you a description, VoicePrint learns you from what you REJECT (the Cheese Gauntlet), what you quote, and how you actually write — then generates a personal SKILL.md + reference files. Works with no corpus, keeps your files in your own workspace, uploads nothing, needs no API key, and proves it's converging instead of promising a one-shot. From the 'Raising Claude' series.
